name: ShingleBeach
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.483

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven ganges_river_pebbles, warmed slightly toward the sand so pebble banks sit in it
known_weaknesses: single scan: the few bright white cobbles are repeating landmarks at 4x4; use the Macro mask to tint
